game.title: Okami HD
game.blurb: High-definition release of the action-adventure in which the sun goddess Amaterasu paints with the Celestial Brush, from Capcom, released 2017-12-12. RAWG average playtime: 4 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: Amaterasu's journey across Nippon, boss by boss, including the Moon Cave and the Water Dragon. Spoiler-guarded; most achievements here are hidden.

chapters.title: Celestial Brush Techniques
chapters.summary: Learning each brush god's technique and filling the Technique Scroll.

chapters.title: Tomes and Collections
chapters.summary: The Fish, Treasure and Animal Tomes, the Bestiary, the Travel Guide, Stray Beads, the Wanted List and maximum Solar Energy, Ink Pot and Astral Pouch.

chapters.title: Devil Gates, Races and Mini-Games
chapters.summary: Devil Gates and trial caves, the Kusa 5, digging mini-games and races against Ida, Hayate and Kai.

chapters.title: Results and Cherry Tree Ranks
chapters.summary: Earning Cherry Tree ranks on the Results and Total Results screens.

StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Ōkami
Fandom (okami.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://okami.fandom.com/wiki/Ōkami_HD
notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki: "Okami HD" redirects to the "Ōkami" guide, which is at completion stage 1. Its Table of Contents lists about 40 walkthrough chapters, but only the Prologue is written; the other written subpages are reference pages (Brush Techniques, Stray Beads, Animals, Characters, Controls, Dojos, Enemies, Travel Guide), so it was not used as a source (not enough written walkthrough). okami.fandom.com answers the API: "Ōkami HD" redirects to the "Ōkami" page, with about 42 linked pages ("Okami HD" without the macron gave no page); names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema calls the app "Flower" (an internal codename); the store list confirms "Okami HD" (587620). 17 of 51 Steam achievements are hidden, with no descriptions; they sit in the main story chapter. The hidden "Top Dog" (earned by 2.8%) may be a completion goal rather than story. RAWG lists a playtime of only 4 hours, which looks low.
